create_generic_model: create a Generic model instance with a name and FileInfoObject for document identification
build_generic_document: build a Generic document representation with name alias and file-info metadata fields
test_generic_serialization: test the Generic model serializes to JSON using field aliases by_alias=True
summarize_generic_fields: summarize the Generic model fields name and file_info with their Pydantic Field configurations
review_generic_class: review the Generic class inheriting from AliasModel with optional StrictStr name and FileInfoObject file_info
